name: Rapicut Carbides Ltd
tagline: Micro-cap tungsten carbide tool maker riding a real, very recent global tungsten supercycle -- unconfirmed in its own numbers yet
business_overview: Rapicut Carbides -- manufacturer of tungsten carbide cutting tools, under relatively new management following an open-offer acquisition.
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 96.3 Cr, profit only Rs 2.06 Cr (thin ~2% net margin)
fundamentals_narrative: A textbook case of a weak multi-year trailing average (near-zero 3yr ROE) alongside a sharp recent-quarter improvement (9.98% TTM ROE) -- but absolute profitability is still thin (Rs 2.06 Cr profit on Rs 96.3 Cr revenue), and the stock trades at 6.16x book value pricing in a lot of hope.
technical_read: Not pulled -- micro-cap, catalyst-driven situation where fundamentals/community signal were the deciding factor.
sentiment_summary: Read all 21 posts in the thread (2019-08 to 2026-08, mostly dormant between 2020 and Aug 2026). Three very recent posts (2026-08-09 and 2026-08-18) surfaced a real, specific, and current catalyst: China cut tungsten export quotas by 6.5% in 2025 and tightened export contingencies, triggering a global tungsten price supercycle; a peer company (Menon Bearings) reported carbide tool prices up 300% YoY in its Aug 2026 concall.
community_signal: No trusted users posted in this thread. The catalyst is external and industry-wide (a genuine commodity supply shock, not company-specific spin), but it is inferred from a peer's concall commentary, not confirmed yet in Rapicut's own results.
bull_case: Real, specific, very recent commodity catalyst: China's 2025 tungsten export quota cuts have triggered a documented supercycle, with a peer citing carbide tool prices up 300% YoY
Recent-quarter ROE/ROCE already showing a sharp improvement versus the weak 3yr trailing average, ahead of full catalyst pass-through
bear_case: Absolute profitability is still thin (Rs 2.06 Cr profit) and the stock has already run up 171% in a year and trades at 6.16x book, pricing in significant optimism
No trusted-user validation, thin community coverage, and the margin benefit is inferred from a peer's commentary rather than confirmed in Rapicut's own numbers yet
verdict_headline: A real commodity-supercycle catalyst for a thin-margin micro-cap -- promising but genuinely unconfirmed
verdict_reasoning: Per this screen's rule on weak trailing averages with a specific, credible recent-quarter catalyst for a small-cap: proceeds at Low conviction with an explicit unconfirmed caveat
Needs Rapicut's own next 1-2 quarters of results to confirm the margin pass-through before conviction can rise; thin community coverage means less independent scrutiny than a larger name would get
notes_short: Tungsten export-quota supercycle (China 2025 cuts) driving carbide tool prices +300% YoY per peer concall -- unconfirmed in Rapicut's own numbers yet

four_box.note: Specific recent-quarter catalyst noted but explicitly unconfirmed; thin community coverage limits scrutiny; no moat/tam/valuation detail in record.

track_record.note: Screener FY18-FY26: rev growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15% both cleared in only 1 of 9 (FY19 10%/15%). A decade of sub-scale, mostly negative-ROCE results (FY20-25 ROCE -6% to 4%); FY26 sales +129% but ROCE still only 11%. Tiny tungsten-carbide tools maker.

quality_metrics.note: Debt-free but sub-scale (Rs96cr sales FY26). ROCE -6% FY25 -> 11% FY26 off a very low base; OPM only 3.1%. EBITDA was negligible/negative across FY24-25 so FCF-conversion ratio is unstable - in absolute terms CFO ~Rs11cr over FY24-26 vs ~Rs2cr capex, so cash-generative but tiny. Capex negligible - not a capex story; a decade of weak returns is the concern.

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: 16x on Rs2cr PAT (first profit in years); needs FY26's 129% revenue jump to prove durable and ROCE to hold double digits
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: revenue growth moderating to 15-25% after the FY26 spike, OPM 4-6%, PAT still sub-Rs5cr
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: import-substitution in tungsten-carbide tooling the structural angle; execution unproven
market_expectation.gap_basis: one strong year (FY26 sales +129%) after a decade of sub-scale, mostly loss-making results; 16x P/E and 8.7x book price a durable turnaround not yet demonstrated.
market_expectation.data_caveat: no broker consensus; implied path is a reverse-P/E estimate + screener.in forward figures + VP thread view
